# Native fraction regression

`fractions.pptx` is the four-page educational artifact authored by the authorized
PPT Master live test on 2026-11-18. It contains no credentials or user documents.
The two body pages use native OMML `1/4` and `3/4` inside groups. Previously they
became empty text without source shape identity, causing Host adoption to fail.
The fixture retains the exact original bytes; no formula was replaced by a picture.
